integrity.coefficient_basis: Deleting diagonal steps gives a Dyck path and reinsertion into gaps gives binomial(2n-k,k) C_{n-k}.
integrity.mode_basis: The exact adjacent-coefficient ratio has its only in-range real crossing at n-sqrt(n(n+1)/2).
integrity.pell_basis: An adjacent tie occurs iff n(n+1)/2 is a square, equivalent to (2n+1)^2-8s^2=1.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The exact source is primary arXiv math.AG; PBW/flag-degeneration literature classifies this geometric family under MSC 14M15.
integrity.source_theorem_basis: The archival source proves P_sm_n(q)=q^{n(n-1)/2} r_n(q), with r_n(q) counting diagonal steps of Schroeder paths.

scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the smooth locus of the complete type-A PBW degenerate flag variety and the q-grading convention of the cited source.
The classical closed formula for the Schroeder coefficient triangle is not claimed as new; the claim is the exact geometric mode and Pell plateau classification.
No claim is made for partial degenerate flags, intersection cohomology, or ring structure.
title: Pell-classified Poincaré plateaus in smooth degenerate flag loci
